question: Six passengers L, M, N, P, Q and R are sitting on a bench in a straight line. They all are facing towards the north. M is sitting immediately between L and R. Q is sitting at the extreme right end of line. M is sitting second to the left of Q. R is sitting to the immediate left of Q. P is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who is sitting to the immediate left of L?
solution:
Given: Six passengers L, M, N, P, Q and R are sitting on a bench in a straight line. They all are facing towards the north.

 
• M is sitting immediately between L and R.
 
• Q is sitting at the extreme right end of line.
 
• M is sitting second to the left of Q.
 
• R is sitting to the immediate left of Q.
 
• P is not an immediate neighbour of L

The Final Arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d929a25f90d3c52cc2ca70f2a9a7f67127fc16c1bf8bc89229538b087cd11b0e.png] 

N sits immediate left of L.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
